matches.rationale: Pred 1 explicitly identifies that the paper uses log base 10 instead of natural log (ln) in the IPCC forcing equation, matching the ground truth exactly, and shows the resulting incorrect temperature values (0.64°C/0.81°C vs correct 1.48°C/1.85°C).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the log10 vs ln error in the radiative forcing equation and its downstream temperature calculation errors.
Flags a dimensional inconsistency in the gas constant/units that is a genuine but different issue not listed in ground truth.
Identifies a separate logical flaw in the anthropogenic CO2 accumulation calculation, unrelated to the log10/ln error.
Critiques the Beer-Lambert law framing as a distinct physics misstatement, not the log10/ln equation error.
Flags equation numbering/labeling confusion, a presentation issue not corresponding to the ground truth defect.
